title: Security Engineering
applicability_rules: Apply to every FATHER-produced software or agent project unless explicitly waived.
Additional controls may be added by Jurisdiction, Customer, Industry or Contract profiles.

controls.title: Security requirements are identified before implementation
controls.requirement: Project requirements shall include applicable security, privacy and access-control requirements.
controls.pass_criteria: Security requirements exist, are traceable to project risks/standards and have acceptance criteria.

controls.title: Data is classified
controls.requirement: Processed, stored and transmitted data shall be classified before architecture approval.
controls.pass_criteria: Data classes, owners, storage locations and transfer paths are documented.

controls.title: Threat model exists for the approved architecture
controls.requirement: Trust boundaries, attack surfaces, abuse cases and material threat scenarios shall be identified.
controls.pass_criteria: Material threats have owners, mitigations, expected loss/residual risk or explicit acceptance.

controls.title: Authorization boundaries are explicitly designed
controls.requirement: Authentication, authorization, privileged actions and tenant/project isolation shall be defined before implementation.
controls.pass_criteria: Security boundaries, roles and denied-by-default behavior are documented and testable.

controls.title: Source code passes automated security checks
controls.requirement: Source changes shall pass SAST, secret scanning and dependency checks where applicable.
controls.pass_criteria: No unresolved blocking findings according to project severity policy.

controls.title: Infrastructure security baseline is verified
controls.requirement: Network zones, trust boundaries, secrets, backup, logging, administrative access and hardening shall be defined and checked.
controls.verification_method: Infrastructure security review and automated checks where available
controls.pass_criteria: Required baseline controls are implemented or formally waived.

controls.title: Security acceptance tests are passed
controls.requirement: Security requirements and material threat scenarios shall have corresponding tests or documented review procedures.
controls.pass_criteria: Blocking security tests pass and residual findings are accepted by the accountable role.

controls.title: Release has an explicit residual-risk decision
controls.requirement: Open material findings and residual risk shall be reviewed before release.
controls.pass_criteria: No unaccepted blocking risk remains; waivers have owner and expiry date.

controls.title: Operational security monitoring exists
controls.requirement: Security-relevant events, incidents, configuration changes and material anomalies shall be observable and reviewable.
controls.pass_criteria: Logging, alerting, incident routing and evidence retention are defined for the project risk profile.
